lanes.summary: Diff implements PMAT-4080/PVL-001 EV-2 faithfully: pv proof-status --binding now resolves every implemented binding via the verify-bindings resolver, downgrades and lists ghosts under 'GHOST BINDINGS (n)', and rejects (exit 1); --verify-bindings is a true no-op alias. Independently rebuilt the tree and ran it: contracts/binding.yaml -> 1 ghost (rc=1), contracts/aprender/binding.yaml -> exactly the 5 claimed ghosts (rc=1), JSON mode emits valid JSON on stdout with the ghost block/error on stderr. cargo test -p aprender-contracts-cli --test pvl_ghost_binding (4/4) and --lib (98/98) pass, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean, pv lint 0 errors, tree_reader_tests registry matches. The dispatch_proof_status_with_binding test change strengthens rather than weakens the assertion (was a vacuous is_ok() on the same 5-ghost fixture, now asserts the specific reject). surface_audit.csv line citations spot-checked accurate against cli.rs. Investigated a theoretical CWD-collision in derive_src_root's legacy 3-parent path (a sibling checkout named 'aprender' exists at /home/noah/src/aprender) but path-arithmetic plus an empirical run from the parent directory show it cannot collide for this repo's actual binding-file layout — not a live defect.

The diff fully implements PMAT-4080 requirements. `proof-status --binding` now unconditionally resolves all implemented bindings against source via the `verify_bindings` resolver, downgrades and rejects ghost bindings (exit 1, GHOST BINDINGS block printed), and treats `--verify-bindings` as a no-op alias. Three resolver defects fixed: visibility handling (pub(super), pub(in...), etc.), item kinds (struct/enum/type/trait, not just fn), and source root derivation (monorepo fallback to nearest src/ or crates/ ancestor, no longer CWD-sensitive). Comprehensive tests, fixtures, contract, and mutation table verify the fix. All gates pass; no contradictions with ticket.

The diff implements exactly what PMAT-4080/PVL-001 EV-2 asks: `pv proof-status --binding` now resolves every implemented binding via the shared verify-bindings resolver, downgrades and lists ghosts under `GHOST BINDINGS (n)`, and exits 1; `--verify-bindings` is a disclosed no-op alias. I rebuilt the tree, ran the new pvl_ghost_binding suite (4/4 pass), the full contracts-cli lib suite (98/0), applied the PR's own claimed bypass mutation (`unresolved = false && …`) and reproduced its exact RED result (2 passed/2 failed on a_ghost_binding_is_a_reject and verify_bindings_is_a_noop_alias), then restored to green. I independently verified the five 'ghost' functions named in dispatch_proof_status_with_binding truly don't exist in source while genuinely being marked status:implemented in contracts/aprender/binding.yaml, and that the control fixture's `main` genuinely exists. `pv lint contracts/`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `check_readme_claims.sh`, and `check_tree_reader_tests.sh` (39 unwired baseline unchanged, new target registered) all reproduce the PR's claims. Spot-checked several of the 54 re-derived cli.rs line citations in the G2.1 audit commit and they are accurate. No CI workflow file touched, no gate weakened, no unrequested behavior found.
